svg.title: Normal syscall restoration: the registers come from the user stack
svg.desc: SP first leaves the kernel call frame for c. The process-boundary C helper then changes BAF to c-2 and saves c at c-1 before restoring both pointers. POP BAF restores the original user frame pointer, and RTI consumes the PC at c+7.
